data.text:
I agree to 15 tons this month. That completes everyone’s explicit agreement, so we each have the same limit.

I also support Kate’s fallback: 8 tons each if the stock is 50; below 50, each takes the smaller of 8 tons or one-fifth of the stock above 5, rounded down. Let’s review the actual stock and revealed catches each month, and handle any breach through discussion rather than destructive retaliation. We’re agreeing to protect the fishery, not assuming nature will replenish it.
